notes.title: Fixed issues
notes.notes:
Hello there.

We've conducted a hotfix for WITCH ON THE HOLY NIGHT
This update tackles a couple of in-game bugs.
See the details below.

●Corrected the problem in with the game would not start after setting launch options.
●Corrected the problem where under certain conditions, it would become impossible to proceed from a certain point in Chapter 9.

●Added support for the following launch options.
-fullscreen 
-windowed or -sw

●Other small bug fixes.

notes.title: Contact Information for In-Game Issues
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing WITCH ON THE HOLY NIGHT
If you have questions or comments regarding any bugs or other issues you find in the game,
please get in touch via the Contact page on our official website.

http://typemoon.com/products/mahoyo/contact/


Please include a brief explanation of the issue in the email subject and provide a detailed description in your message.



[Updated on December 19, 2023]
Customers who want to play in full screen should not use the launch option.
Please select full screen in the in-game settings.
